summary: Most frontend landing-page sections are implemented (hero with CTA, countdown to Feb 14 2026, syllabus, interactive preview, FAQ accordion, waitlist form with backend call, and a local scripted chatbot). Key backend requirement for stable storage is not met, and some chatbot/FAQ/preview copy introduces disallowed external LLM/tool references (Claude Sonnet 4.5, Emergent).

missing_requirements.requirement: Store waitlist entries in stable state within the single Motoko main actor (stable persistence across upgrades).
missing_requirements.reason: The backend uses `let waitlist = Map.empty<Text, Text>();` which is not declared as `stable` and there is no stable structure / preupgrade-postupgrade handling shown.

hallucinated_features.description: References to Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Emergent AI as tools used/covered in the course (and in chatbot intent matching).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest Non-goals explicitly say not to integrate Claude Sonnet 4.5, Emergent, or external LLM/chat APIs; these mentions introduce unrequested/disallowed external AI/tool branding in the content.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity provider/hooks wiring added to the app.
hallucinated_features.reason: Authentication was not required for the waitlist; adding II is extra functionality not requested (though not necessarily harmful).

hallucinated_features.description: Footer includes an external promotional link to caffeine.ai.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in BuildRequest; adds unrelated outbound link/branding.
